description: Creates a knowledge base from text and/or URLs. To make an assistant use it, pass agent_id here (auto-links), or add the id to the assistant's knowledge_base_ids via call2me_update_agent. Provide at least one text or URL.

agent_id.description: Assistant to link the knowledge base to (optional).

urls.description: Web page URLs to crawl and index (max 10).

name: call2me_create_knowledge_base
title: Create knowledge base
